Percentages are based on the number of enrolled patients.
The Safety population includes all patients who have received at least one dose of CPX-POM.
The Efficacy population includes all patients who have received at least one dose of CPX-POM and had available tumor tissue at
baseline and at the time of radical cystectomy.
